title: Implement automation/digital IO characteristic mappings (K.3.7)
description:
Add to gatt_ipso.c static table, automation/IO characteristics:

- Digital (Input/Output) 0x2A56 -> 3200/5500, bool
- Analog Input 0x2A58 -> 3202/5600, 1
- Analog Output 0x2A59 -> 3202/5600, 1
- Aggregate Input 0x2A5A -> 3200/5500, bitmap

~4 entries. Reference: spec/appendix-gatt-ipso.md K.3.7
